I sent Pree her list as a reply in our direct message. I found three ticket numbers for Marrow Fieldworks:

1. #4409: a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard. This is from Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week," dated 2 Jan 2026.
2. #4412: a glitch in the driver text-message prompt when combine trailers are staged on unpaved overflow lots. This is from the same Moss digest.
3. PD-5302: a follow-up from this week. Hollis posted it in #central-random on 14 Oct.

I told her about one more I couldn't confirm. Tobias raised #8841 in #central-random on 13 Oct about "Tobias's dealer account," but the thread never names Marrow Fieldworks.

I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 and told her why: both are for Marrow Agrisupply, which is a different account. Moss's Central cheat sheet has no ticket numbers. Nothing else came up this week in #central-team or the other channels she's in.

I only used what Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team, the other channels she belongs to, public files, and our direct message. Ticket numbers aren't finance figures, so no approval was needed.
